# spec: Front Headlamp (LED)

## Product Type

Front headlamp — exterior lighting module combining passing beam, driving beam, front position lamp and daytime running lamp behind a common outer lens.

## Vehicle Category

M1 — passenger car. UNECE lighting regulations referenced apply across M and N categories.

## Function

- Passing beam (low beam) with asymmetric cut-off
- Driving beam (high beam)
- Front position signalling
- Daytime running lamp (DRL)
- Light transmission & protection of optics (outer lens)
- Headlamp levelling (manual adjustment via actuator)

## Main Parts

- Housing
- Outer lens
- Passing beam projector module
- Driving beam reflector module
- DRL / position light guide
- Bezel
- Levelling actuator
- Heat sink
- Electronic control unit (LED driver)

## Materials

Representative values — confirm against actual bill of materials.


| Component            | Typical material(s)                              |
| -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| Outer lens           | PC with hard-coat (UV and scratch resistant)     |
| Housing              | PP-T40 or PC/PBT                                 |
| Bezel                | PC with aluminium vacuum-metallised coating      |
| Projector lens       | PMMA or glass                                    |
| Reflector            | BMC with aluminium vacuum-metallised coating     |
| Light guide          | PMMA (optical grade)                             |
| Light source         | LED modules on metal-core PCB                    |
| Heat sink            | Die-cast aluminium (AlSi10Mg)                    |
| Seal / gasket        | Butyl hot-melt or silicone                       |
| Levelling actuator   | PA66-GF30 housing, DC stepper motor              |
| Fasteners / clips    | PA, POM, or steel                                |

## Electrical

- Nominal voltage: 12 V DC
- Passing beam power: approx. 18 W
- Driving beam power: approx. 22 W
- DRL power: approx. 8 W
